about.heading: Java Developer & Full-Stack Web Engineer
about.biography: I'm Subhaharini, an innovative and result-driven software developer pursuing B.Sc. Computer Technology at Rathinam Group of Institutions (2024–2027). I'm passionate about building scalable, real-world solutions and actively involved in the design phase, with a keen interest in UI/UX and creating user-centric experiences. Driven by a deep passion for Java, web development, and software architecture, I bring precision and detail to every system I architect and software application I build.

faqs.question: What technical stacks and programming languages does Subhaharini use?
faqs.answer: Subhaharini is highly skilled in Core Java (Oracle Certified Associate) and web development technologies. Her stack includes Java, C, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Bun.js, and Elysia.js.

faqs.question: What are some of Subhaharini's award-winning projects?
faqs.answer: Subhaharini has architected Zentix, a real-time smart campus navigation and resource tracking system, and SkipQ, a scalable queue management system that optimized wait times by 35%.

faqs.question: Has Subhaharini won any hackathons or competitions?
faqs.answer: Yes, she is a state-level hackathon competitor. Her awards include the Special Prize at the TN-IMPACT 2026 Industrial Hackathon, 1st place in AlgoRhythm '26, and Best Manager at Hindustan College.

items.name: SheBloom
items.desc: Capacitor-wrapped Next.js pregnancy and maternal care tracking and assistant app for caretakers. Features Bun + Elysia API, Neon PostgreSQL DB, real-time ESP32 IoT environmental telemetrics over WebSockets, and zero-telecom cost localized Tamil audio care alerts.

items.name: Zentix
items.desc: Real-time campus mapping and spatial tracking system that resolves routing and location checks. Built to support sub-200ms latency metrics.

items.name: SkipQ
items.desc: High-concurrency queue optimization system designed to manage and reduce customer wait times. Handled simulated parallel client request bounds.
